DZA.note: Nothing on rules against AI harms.
The AI platform serves higher-education orientation, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: On 29 April 2024 the Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research launched a digital platform using artificial intelligence and data mining that simulates study-field choices for new baccalaureate holders from their subject marks and gives estimated efficiency rates.

systems.owner: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
